result: The step strip's current step and the chosen page-image label are marks, not primary presses: the batch page shows exactly one ul-btn--primary in every tested state, the strip included, and each Add files view shows one.
decisions: StepStrip: every step renders the default (secondary) Button; the current step keeps aria-current step. Batch.module.css '.steps [aria-current="step"]' gives ink text and a 2 px inset bottom shadow in --ui-primary as the underline, so the focus outline is untouched.
PageImageQuestion: every label is soft; the chosen one keeps aria-pressed true and gets the same mark through '.question [role="group"] [aria-pressed="true"]'.

AddFilesDialog and IntakeDropDialog already had one primary per view (building files: Start import; new files: Continue, then Start import at the profile check's import step; saved batch: Start import; batch step: Add n files). No variant changed. The saved batch's loading and could-not-open views have no primary, only Close.

inputs.captured: docs/evidence/gf1/lq1a/controls-second.json and docs/evidence/gf1/e3b/targets.json (batch page); apps/studio/src/local/data/lake-view/import-batches.json (saved batch and its building id)
inputs.test_only: a page-image item with G23's read facts for the CubiCasa plan PNG, no preview, answered plan as a candidate; the NYC profile check's answer is a control value with no file facts

checks.command: cd apps/studio; npx vitest run src/features/intake

tests: primary-press.test.tsx counts every ul-btn--primary, the strip included: one in each of a layout to answer, a table to read, packages to record and a page image answered; the current step is one button with aria-current step and only the ul-btn class; pressed choices are soft (Plan in the page-image case). page-image-question.test.tsx: after an answer no primary and four soft labels. add-files-continue.test.tsx: one primary in building files, a saved batch, new files before a drop, the batch step, and both steps of the profile check.
